stem.text: Chlorine is bubbled through a cylinder containing aqueous sodium iodide and an immiscible layer of hexane.

stem.alt: Gas-washing apparatus: a cylinder with a tube from chlorine gas entering near the bottom, bubbles rising, an outlet at the top labelled excess gas out, and two layers labelled hexane (upper) and aqueous sodium iodide (lower).

stem.text: As the bubbles pass through the cylinder, what is observed in the lower and upper layers?

A.text: colourless solution becomes brown; colourless liquid becomes coloured

B.text: colourless solution becomes brown; colourless liquid is unchanged

C.text: brown solution becomes colourless; colourless liquid becomes coloured

D.text: brown solution becomes colourless; colourless liquid is unchanged
